existing_authority_issues.detail: All four front references now bind the existing SKU-specific physical-authority photos with matching historical hashes. Shirt chest placement and bridge-filled petals, shorts waistband colors and wearer-left roses follow those sources. Superseded reference/dossier snapshots are retained inside each product record. This resolves front artwork sourcing; it does not certify a new render or a rear-view source.

Catalog/registry specify silicone patch and color variants; dossier specifies embroidered mixed graphic variants. Inspected tech flat contains visibly different rose treatments, so one default cluster does not prove all variant identities. Preserve current catalog specification until reconciled.

Dossiers and tech flats show a separate small rear SR. The plain SR reference is distinct from the rose-bearing site-wide primary. Bind its exact source/version before adding a registry logo ID; do not alias it to the first rose.
